description: State management with Riverpod: Create all Riverpod providers for authentication state, user data, chat rooms list, and messages. Use riverpod_annotation for code generation. Providers must handle loading, error, and data states properly. This feature is dependent on FEAT-001 (models and services must exist first).
steps: Create d:\higo\lib\providers\auth_provider.dart with StateNotifierProvider for auth state (idle, loading, authenticated, error) and methods for signUp, signIn, signOut using auth_service
Create d:\higo\lib\providers\user_provider.dart with StreamProvider to listen to current user document changes in Firestore
Create d:\higo\lib\providers\chat_rooms_provider.dart with StreamProvider to fetch all chat rooms for current user with real-time updates
Create d:\higo\lib\providers\messages_provider.dart with family StreamProvider to fetch messages for a specific chat room with pagination support
Create d:\higo\lib\providers\cache_provider.dart with Provider for cache_service to persist user data locally
Run 'flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs' to generate riverpod code
acceptance_criteria: All providers are created using riverpod_annotation with proper type annotations
Auth provider manages authentication lifecycle (loading, success, error states)
StreamProviders properly listen to Firestore real-time updates
verification: cd d:\higo && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
findings: All providers successfully created with riverpod_annotation. Generated code includes: auth_provider (StateNotifier for authentication), user_provider (StreamProvider for current user), chat_rooms_provider (StreamProvider for chat rooms list), messages_provider (family StreamProvider for per-room messages with pagination), and cache_provider (Provider for cache service). build_runner generated all .g.dart files successfully. flutter analyze shows no issues.
